admission.justification: Removing the printed path without a route to the report would have made a written report unreachable; the rule spans Result, the fetch, the shared reader and the route call. The chat frame stays the same mounted element while the reader is open and after it closes; the supplied report reader is conditionally unmounted on Back, and the frame — not the reader — is what persists.

applicability: The Result control of the launcher bar for any selected execution.
conditions: A written report opens in the dashboard's existing notes reader.
A report that is not written names that absence in the one line of rule 3.
exclusions: No second viewer or bespoke report UI is built.
The report's own content and the serving route's confinement are rule 4a's obligation, not this one.
statement: Result refreshes selected execution and opens its written report in the existing Notes Reader or names its absence.
